task: Review the new notification system, discover its problems, and fix them.

findings.title: Docs over-claim broadcast_failed 'error for hard failures'
findings.detail: §3.1 severity note states broadcast_failed from _run_campaign finalization uses 'error' severity for hard failures, but finalization only publishes broadcast_failed (warning) for cancellations and broadcast_completed (info) otherwise. A campaign only reaches FAILED status via recover(), which emits no system event, so the 'error for hard failures' path is unimplemented.

findings.title: Broadcaster.cancel() retains unused bot parameter
findings.detail: After the duplicate system-event publish was removed, bot is no longer referenced in cancel(). All four call sites still pass bot. Low-priority cleanup; harmless if left for API stability.
